info.title: KINAN Partner API
info.summary: Server-to-server API for approved partner stores.
info.description:
Batch 1: identity and the catalogue (snapshot + change feed). Batch 2: quotes and orders. Batch 3: fulfilment progress, shipments, cancellations, returns (RMA), documents and signed webhooks, plus a sandbox simulator. Quotes, orders and everything after them are switched on by KINAN and are sandbox only for now. Additive changes only within v1.

Webhooks: every POST carries KINAN-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with your endpoint secret>. Reject requests older than 5 minutes and compare in constant time. Answer 2xx within 10 seconds; anything else is retried with backoff for 24 hours, then the delivery is dead and can be replayed. Delivery order is not guaranteed: apply data only if data.version is newer than yours, and treat GET /orders/{order_id} as the truth.

Conventions: JSON over HTTPS, ISO 8601 UTC times, ISO 4217 currencies, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries, money as integer minor units with an explicit currency. Every response has an X-Request-Id header. Errors use RFC 9457 application/problem+json. The sandbox (knp_test_ keys) serves a synthetic catalogue only.

servers.description: KINAN (sandbox or live is decided by the key)

get.description: Environment, organisation, store, scopes, enabled markets, locales and currencies for the calling key.

Products your store is entitled to in one market, ordered by product_id. Keep following next_cursor; the last page returns sync_cursor, bound to the change-feed position when the first page was read. Writes during the snapshot are replayed by /catalog/changes.

get.summary: Ordered catalogue changes since a cursor
get.description: Apply events in seq order. upsert carries the current product projection; withdraw means stop selling and unpublish (it is also sent for products you are no longer entitled to, and is a no-op if you never had the product). Versions only increase: ignore anything older than what you hold. Store next_cursor atomically with the effects. 410 CURSOR_EXPIRED means rebuild from a new snapshot.

post.summary: Price a basket for a destination
post.description: Validates the destination and every line, prices it from your price list and returns a locked quote that expires (15 minutes by default). A quote does not reserve stock. Check the quote before you take your customer’s payment where you can.

post.summary: Place a B2B order from a quote
post.description: Exactly once per Idempotency-Key: a retry with the same key and body returns the original answer (header Idempotent-Replayed: true); the same key with another body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; a new key with an external_order_ref already used is 409 ORDER_REFERENCE_CONFLICT. Stock KINAN controls is reserved. Fulfilment starts only after settlement or approved terms. Your external_order_ref links your retail order; it never proves payment to KINAN.

get.description: One shipment per ship-from origin, with carrier, tracking number and events. Scope: orders:read.

post.description: Needs an Idempotency-Key. Before handoff the cancellation is accepted at once: reservations are released and a settled payment is credited. After handoff it is requested and KINAN decides. Shipped orders answer 409 ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE: request a return after delivery. A second cancellation while one is open is 409 CANCELLATION_PENDING. Scope: orders:write.

Needs an Idempotency-Key. Only delivered items, within 30 days of delivery, up to the quantity not already returned; otherwise 409 RETURN_NOT_ALLOWED with per-line errors. KINAN approves (with return instructions and the RMA number) or rejects, then marks it received and credits the goods value. Scope: returns:write.

get.description: Pro-forma invoice always; packing slip once handed off; a credit note per credited return or credited cancellation. Sandbox documents are test data, not tax documents. Live answers 503 until KINAN’s invoicing entity is set up. Scope: documents:read.

post.description: Sandbox keys only (403 otherwise). Lets you test every state and webhook without waiting for KINAN: handoff, ship (one origin or all), deliver, exception, and KINAN’s decisions on cancellations and returns. Payment is still marked by KINAN in the sandbox. Scope: orders:write.

HTTPS on a public address only (private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused, also after DNS). At most 5 per store. The endpoint receives nothing until it passes verification. Scope: webhooks:manage.

delete.description: Queued deliveries to it are dropped. To rotate a secret, create a new endpoint, verify it, then delete the old one. Scope: webhooks:manage.

post.description: KINAN POSTs a signed endpoint.verification event; answer 2xx with {"challenge": data.challenge}. Otherwise 422 ENDPOINT_VERIFICATION_FAILED. Scope: webhooks:manage.
Queues the event again with the same event id (for example a dead delivery, or one you lost). Your handler must be idempotent on the event id. Scope: webhooks:manage.

partnerKey.description: Store key issued by KINAN. Shown once; rotate by issuing a new key and revoking the old one.

RequestId.description: Unique id of this request; quote it to KINAN support.

idem.name: Idempotency-Key
idem.description: Unique per new order; reuse it for retries of the same order. Kept for 30 days.

sellable_quantity.description: Only where backed by inventory KINAN controls.

version.description: Grows whenever anything in this projection changes for your store.

content_locale.description: Locale the text was actually taken from (fallback: language, then en).

ships_from.description: Country the goods ship from (fulfilment location).

sync_cursor.description: Present on the last page only.

ship_from.description: ISO country of the origin (one shipment per origin)

Cancellation.description: accepted at once before handoff to fulfilment; requested (KINAN decides) after handoff. Shipped orders cannot be cancelled: use a return.

instructions.description: Set when approved: where and how to send the parcel back

credit_minor.description: Goods value ex tax credited when the return is credited; shipping is not credited

sandbox.description: Sandbox documents are test data and not tax documents

url.description: https:// on a public host. No credentials in the URL.

WebhookEvent.description: Body of each webhook POST (see the signature rules above). data is the Order (status part), Shipment, Cancellation or Return, never recipient data.

Gone.description: Cursor older than the retention window: rebuild from a snapshot

Unprocessable.description: Market not enabled for the store

Conflict.description: Conflict: quote expired or mismatched, stock changed, idempotency or order-reference conflict, an order that can no longer be cancelled or returned, or a state that does not allow this step. Read the code.

200.description: Any 2xx within 10 seconds acknowledges the event
